chip.description: Eight-channel PCM sample player with 64 KB of on-die waveform RAM, mapped as a register block plus a wave-RAM window (taxonomy §4.14 example).
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/rf5c68.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("ricoh RF5C68(or clone) PCM controller"). The custom-parts table in src/mame/sega/segaic16.cpp records that Sega System 18 and System 32 fit the same part, "also seen as 315-5476A and ASSP 5c105 and ASSP 5c68a"; MAME's rf5c164 device is the Mega-CD relative.
